facts.did: 回到宿舍发现 Cobblestone 的空格间已装满书，推断 Memory 在他们离开 Tentacle 期间分派了新的同簇者
facts.anchor: Cobblestone’s empty cubby was now full of books

facts.did: 从窗口窥看后滑进房间，宣布 Memory 允许部分人换房、自己申请加入 Gardenpath 的簇（原簇在第二次考试中少了两人），并滚过去高兴地轻推 Gardenpath
facts.anchor: I requested to join your cluster! You were down one person

facts.did: 从摊平状态聚起喷出一句阴沉的话：第二次考试不是玩笑，Plumline 每七个 journey 操练它一次以保持备战
facts.anchor: Plumline drills me every seven journeys

facts.did: 刺立起来继续和 Wainscot 就无关之事斗嘴（说出“War comes to distant worlds as well.”）；Oriel 退到盆里缩成椭圆
facts.anchor: Gardenpath spiked and continued to banter with Wainscot

facts.did: 同簇合时发现自己膜在 Oriel 面前反常变薄、欲望上涌，勉力压下后才按维护的节奏打开膜
facts.anchor: Gardenpath’s membrane opened to its rhythms

facts.did: 簇合后的分离时发现自己有一根半成形的触手在 Oriel 体内，带着一阵羞耻猛地抽出，并假装昏沉敷衍众人
facts.anchor: a tentacle half formed inside Oriel

facts.did: 问“Can I hug you?”后张开六条臂温暖地环抱 Gardenpath
facts.anchor: stretched out six arms to wrap warmly around them

facts.did: 被拥抱后意识到必须尽快脱身，抓起一只桨船前往 Transit Hall，去缩小成另一个人
facts.anchor: They grabbed a paddler and headed to the Transit Hall
